RFC9256-2.6-3.note: TestRFC9256SymbolicNamesAreNotIdentifiers drives parseConfigRoute: differing policy and candidate-path names give byte-identical NLRI keys while the names still reach the Tunnel Encapsulation attribute (positive), and a shared name with a different distinguisher gives distinct keys (negative), so the name never takes part in identity.

RFC9256-5.1-4.note: ze verifies no SID reachability, so every SID must be Type A or B; TestRFC9256SegmentTypesAreAOrB shows parseSegmentList and buildSegmentSubSubTLV emit only sub-TLV 1 and 13 and that type-c, type-d, type-i and type-k are refused; the row carries its single-polarity marker.
